flows.expected: version, joycraft.release and releaseVersion are 1.9.1; summary is one line of at most 300 characters; CHANGELOG has a '## 1.9.1 — ' entry above 1.9.0.

observations.actual: 39 of 39 tests in 2 files pass after pnpm build, including both [AC:release-fields] [AC:spec-8-1] tests. package.json version and joycraft.release are 1.9.1, src/joycraft-release.json releaseVersion is 1.9.1, the summary is one line (about 230 characters), and '## 1.9.1 — Fixes from the 1.9.0 reviews' sits directly above '## 1.9.0 —' with an '### Update notes' line naming package.json, tsconfig*.json and lockfiles under the docs root. The public-docs diff adds only the [AC:spec-8-1] tag to two titles (class 1, as Test changes declares).

Release diff touches package.json (version, release, summary), src/joycraft-release.json (releaseVersion) and tests/public-docs.test.ts (two title tags); tests/release-preparation.test.ts is not in the diff.

flows.representativeInput: tests/release-preparation.test.ts (unchanged) and the CHANGELOG 1.9.1 entry checked by hand against specs 1-7 and 9
flows.expected: The CHANGELOG entry lists the fixes in a few lines with the docs-root manifest update note; release-preparation passes unchanged.

observations.actual: tests/release-preparation.test.ts passes, and the diff receipt shows it unchanged from origin/main. Every CHANGELOG 1.9.1 claim was checked against the landed code: runner aliases (completion.mjs runnerCommand: npx, pnpm/npm exec, run of pnpm/npm/yarn run) and the done re-check skip (gateRuns false when status is done); chained gates and the scope section (queue-check.mjs chain pattern, sectionBullets for implementation-and-verification-scope); manifests (delivery.mjs manifest regex checked before the record rule); projectRoot exported from cleanup.mjs and used by cleanup main and archive main; .MD/.markdown relink; comment-only next with the run-the-gate text (spec 9); latestReport receipts for an unaccepted spec; blank --owner-instruction message; new-doc backlogFile, age-out -z, case-mismatch message, piped notFound skip; reference text in cleanup.md, setup.md, testing-review.md, testing-page.md, archive.md and delivery.md; payload guard pin. No claim lacks code. The entry names no field project, person, private path or commit SHA (grep for hex runs, /Users, names: none).

limits: Gate not run (reviewer runs only the spec's own tests, per the brief); due at the coordinator's gate.

findings.summary: spec-8-2 has no [AC:spec-8-2] tagged test: the spec asks release-preparation.test.ts to pass unchanged, so adding a tag would break 'unchanged'. Covered by the focused run and the diff receipt.

Update note says the manifests 'counted as records' before. True for package.json and tsconfig*.json anywhere under the docs root and for pnpm-lock.yaml in feature/archive folders, but yarn.lock, bun.lockb and deno.lock never matched a record extension, so they already needed the gate. Slight overstatement; harmless.

delivery.md now tells agents to save a probe script kept as a receipt with a .txt suffix; the CHANGELOG 'Changed' line mentions only 'the record extensions in delivery.md'. Minor omission of a user-visible instruction.

The spec bullet says the entry lists specs 1 to 7, but the queue makes spec 8 depend on spec 9 too; commit 8e6abf8 added spec 9's change (sure-comment rule and run-the-gate text). The entry covers 1-7 and 9, which is the brief's intent.
The spec says to run /release-docs-sync before the PR; that is a PR-time step for the coordinator, not checked here.
